clips.title: The story
paras: Rime's Wrath is a quest focused on quelling a hazardous outbreak of minor ice elementals. Because methods to peacefully soothe the aggressive frost spirits were unknown, eliminating them became necessary to keep the area safe.

Rime's Wrath involves dealing with a localized surge of minor ice elementals. These spirits of biting frost and cold have become an active danger in the area, necessitating swift intervention before their chill spreads further or harms passersby. Rather than a coordinated assault, the response is a containment measure against wild, hostile elemental manifestations.

While the preferred outcome was to soothe the agitated frost spirits, the knowledge required to placate them was out of reach. With no practical means of pacification available and the spirits growing increasingly perilous, the only remaining choice was to destroy them to protect the surrounding territory.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average traveler or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
